description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewVcard' that extends 'SugarView'. It is responsible for handling the display of a vCard view in the SuiteCRM application. The display method loads contact details by ID and saves the vCard.

classes.name: ViewVcard
classes.description: A PHP class for generating a vCard for a contact in SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarView class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads contact data by ID and saves the contact as a vCard.
